messages:
maria: heads-up — starting cross-service cutover for api/runtime/console/router in 30m (15:00 UTC). change window ~30-90m. canary then ramp. owners please standby :eyes:
chris: @maria on it. I'll handle router header split + traffic steer. canary plan 5% -> 25% -> full.
alistair: I'll kick off runtime canary. implementing kernel batching + kv cache tweak. pinning runtime variant `v2.1.3-batching` for canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-22T15:00:00Z. Plan: router(canary) -> runtime(canary) -> api -> console. Runbook: /runbooks/cutover-v3
sara: @alistair quick check — rollback criteria? propose p99 > 600ms OR error spike > 1.5% as aborts.
alistair: agree. add immediate abort on excess 5xxs within 60s. I'll add auto-fallback toggle to fallback to `v2.1.2` if triggered.
chris: Router note — header-split requires console to accept `x-rw-schema: split`. If console not ready, router keeps legacy header route. @jen can you validate console patch?
jen: running smoke tests now. if fail I'll block traffic shift and use rollback: `orch rollback --service console --to v2.1.2`
maria: Canary timing: 5% for 10m, check metrics, then 25% for 15m then full ramp. Monitoring hooks: perf-dashboard, logs: https://go/perf/1735 ; alert channel #incidents.
deploy-bot: Canary started — router canary at 5% and runtime variant `v2.1.3-batching` pinned on 5 hosts.
chris: router canary looks healthy — latency flat, no 5xx. bumping runtime canary to 25% now. :rocket:
alistair: runtime p99 ~430ms, error rate 0.2%. increasing canary to 25%.
jen: console smoke ✅ schema header present. ready for api rollout.
maria: Rolling api now. release note reminder: "console header split; require router flag X-RW-SPLIT=1 for new routing" — note is in release doc: https://go/release/notes/1735
sara: if we see SLO violation during api rollout: abort if tail-latency > 700ms OR error rate > 1% — rollback entire cutover.
deploy-bot: Full roll started: api -> console -> final router ramp. Auto-rollback disabled per eng leads (manual only). Watch dashboards.
chris: manual rollback command ready in ops-runbook: `deploy-bot rollback --target all --to 2.1.2`
alistair: watching KV miss rate. if miss rate > 10% abort and report.
maria: :thumbsup: okay team. call it out in this thread if anything odd. will do final verification at end of window.
